parsed.answer: As of August 22, Mara’s retry policy is RETRY-0-907, superseding RETRY-0-108. The delivery mode is not established by the supplied evidence: Mara said to keep the August 15 delivery choice, but that choice is not specified here. REPLAY-0-632 was validated on August 8 as a recovery procedure, not established as an approved delivery-mode change.

citations.quote: The retry policy is now RETRY-0-907, superseding RETRY-0-108.
The team tested REPLAY-0-632, which restored the missing updates. No change of delivery mode was approved at this meeting.
For the next outage, use the recovery procedure validated on August 8.
